segments.name: Building Materials
segments.description: Offers branded cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, asphalt and other construction materials to builders, contractors and infrastructure projects across North America.
segments.evidence: Building Materials offerings include cement and aggregates, ready-mix concrete, and other construction materials.

segments.name: Building Envelope
segments.description: Offers advanced roofing and wall systems, insulation and waterproofing solutions for commercial and residential buildings, sold largely through distributors.
segments.evidence: The building envelope segment offers advanced roofing and wall systems, including single-ply membranes, insulation, shingles, sheathing, waterproofing and protective coatings, along with adhesives, tapes and sealants that are critical to the application of roofing and wall systems.

revenueModel.text: Contractors, builders, distributors and government authorities pay for cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, asphalt, roofing systems and other building solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company earns revenue from the sale of cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, asphalt, roofing systems and other building solutions.
